statements.text: Along with ushering new critical manufacturing, our region is one of the fastest-growing data center hubs in the country. These facilities are powering the AI revolution, but they can’t solely run on weather-dependent power sources and wishful thinking. They need steady, around-the-clock electricity.
statements.venue: Op-ed in The Washington Times, 'Paving the way for America's energy comeback'

statements.text:
To power the AI revolution, we need enough baseload energy to run the data centers in Ohio & across the U.S.

While the private sector is working hard to keep up, @POTUS & Congress are focused on meeting our growing energy demands by bringing affordable, reliable power online. 🔌 https://t.co/vkh3vNTtPd
These data centers are going to have to find their own power source. We cannot put that on the backs of our constituents,
statements.venue: Zanesville-Muskingum County Chamber legislative breakfast, reported by WHIZ News

statements.text:
Ridgewood High School’s AI for Youth class are Ohio state champions in the Presidential AI Challenge. 

Today, they shared their winning “Reading Reimagined” project with me, which is designed to improve student literacy through personalized reading experiences and deeper engagement with learners.

Congratulations, and keep innovating!

Winning the #AI race while lowering energy costs for families starts with smart policymaking and unleashing American energy. 

Appreciate @SecretaryWright joining us on Capitol Hill to highlight Ohio’s growing role in powering our nation. https://t.co/fC5MaJ074X
statements.quoted:
As we work to win the race for AI, we need to make sure that Americans aren't paying more for electricity.

Today, @RepBalderson spoke with @SecretaryWright about @POTUS' Ratepayer Protection Pledge, which will ensure AI companies—not consumers—are paying for the electricity they use.

statements.text:
Congratulations to Ranvir Singh, the Congressional App Challenge winner from OH-12! 👏

Inspired by his own experience managing diabetes, Ranvir created MetricSync, an AI-powered app that analyzes meals from a photo or description and delivers instant nutrition insights.

Proud to see Ohio students leading in innovation and STEM!
